name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 8 visits over 19 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 20 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.29 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
